claims.claim: The RGB luminosity bump is a temporary decrease in luminosity against the otherwise increasing trend on the red-giant branch.
claims.episode_span: A temporary decrease in luminosity interrupts this steady rise and appears in color-magnitude diagrams of stellar clusters as the RGB luminosity bump.
claims.source_title: Why aging stars suffer a sudden luminosity dip
claims.supporting_quote: The luminosity bump is a temporary decrease in luminosity against this otherwise increasing trend.

claims.claim: Euclid's first major data release identified 15,000 new strong gravitational-lens candidates.
claims.episode_span: Before Euclid fewer than 1,000 confirmed strong lenses were known; the new catalog adds 15,000 candidates, the largest collection assembled.
claims.source_title: Dark matter–hunting satellite Euclid reveals record number of cosmic 'magnifying glasses'
claims.supporting_quote: Before Euclid, we had fewer than 1,000 confirmed strong lenses. Now we have 15,000 new candidates.

claims.claim: Reanalysis of UHZ1 using new X-ray and infrared data finds no signs of hidden black-hole activity.
claims.episode_span: New X-ray data combined with fresh infrared observations show no detectable hidden black-hole activity.
claims.source_title: New observations challenge evidence for an 'outsize' black hole in the early universe
claims.supporting_quote: A recent reanalysis of the outsize black hole galaxy UHZ1 using existing X-ray data and new infrared observations challenges a previous groundbreaking claim.
